name: Chat Note
description: Casual conversation summary — the template Plaud auto-selects for informal talks.
source: Reconstructed from Plaud template id casual-conversation (name, AUTO-SELECT behaviour).
outline: Summarize an informal conversation in a warm, readable way without inventing detail.
Open with a short overall summary of what the conversation was about.
Describe the mood/atmosphere of the conversation in one or two sentences.
Capture the main topics discussed as concise bullet points, in the order they came up.
List any concrete agreements, plans or next steps mentioned (omit the section if there were none).
Keep the tone natural and avoid corporate/meeting jargon.
